en: Ha! Another one comes in out of the cold! I'm Wulfric, and this Gym is the coldest place in Kalos. Ha ha!
Ice is patient. It waits, it grows, and one day it moves mountains. Let's see if you can move it!
Ha ha ha! You melted the lot of us! That's the best fun I've had all winter.
The Iceberg Badge. Eight! Now you're ready for the road to the League.
{player} received the Iceberg Badge from Wulfric!
Take this too. A storm of hail and wind that freezes everything in its way!
North of town, through the woods and past the village, Victory Road waits. Go on, then!
Ha! You've come a long way, but not far enough. Kalos has bigger trouble than me just now: go and stop it first.
Ha ha! Show the League what a little cold can do!
Hello there, future Champion! Wulfric's Ice types crack under fire, fists, rock and steel. Choose well!
You beat Wulfric! I could hear him laughing from the door.
